reference_sql:
WITH late_march AS (
  -- one row per order line sold from 17 to 31 March 2025 (UTC days): only the columns the totals need
  SELECT store_code, units, net_revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-17' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT store_code, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
FROM late_march
GROUP BY store_code

WITH late_march AS (
  -- one row per order line sold from 17 to 31 March 2025 (UTC days): only the columns the totals need
  SELECT store_code, units, net_revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_month = DATE '2025-03-01'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2025-03-17'
)
SELECT store_code, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
FROM late_march
GROUP BY store_code
